fit_legend.FOCUSED_NEW: New authored Core1A and different Core1B practice, source answer not certified.

fit_legend.MISSING_CONSTRUCTION: No existing interactive lesson covers the crucial physical operation; do not invent an equivalence.

questions.source_science_note: The suggested Mg(√2−1) follows from an ideal constant horizontal force starting at rest and reaching 45° as a turning point: F Lsinθ = Mg L(1−cosθ). Holding the mass statically at θ=45° requires F=Mg tanθ=Mg. The original prompt does not explicitly distinguish these.
